localFacts.fact: Muy Interesante, with NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (The Lancet) data: in 2019 men in Spain averaged 1,76 m and women 1,62 m. Replaces the CDC US averages in the eye-level section.
Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm. The Befree GT XPRO (43 cm), Feisol and MT190XPRO4 (49 cm) and 055 (54 cm) fit lengthwise; the Vanguard VEO 3+ kit (77 cm) does not.
Vanguard España sells the Veo 3+ 263AB160S with the VEO BH-160S dual-axis Arca-type ball head and the VEO+ MA1 adapter for a second head or accessories; it extends to 174 cm.

Spanish terms: rótula de bola (ball head), columna central, zapata / placa de liberación rápida; retrato corporativo or foto de perfil profesional are the common words for a headshot; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Buyers ask how tall the tripod must be; forum advice is legs with the column down of about 1,40 m so they can shoot at eye level without bending.
localPainPoints.fix: The Feisol and 055 (140 cm), Befree (142 cm) and Vanguard (148 cm) reach that with the column down; the MT190XPRO4 has 135 cm (post: lens-height section).

quotes.text: un trípode que con las patas extendidas y la columna central bajada mida 1,40, ya te sirve para disparar a nivel del ojo.

localPainPoints.pain: Forum users warn that the higher the tripod goes, the less stable it gets.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the column down for the steadiest shot and raise it only for the last centimetres between clients (post: comparison table intro and how-to step 5).

localPainPoints.pain: Forum advice says the tripod plus camera should reach face height when fully extended.
localPainPoints.fix: Lens height = legs + about 17 cm of head and camera, worked out for Spanish averages (local gain).

quotes.text: la altura debería quedarte, una vez desplegado por completo, a la altura de la cara (incluyendo la cámara).

localGain.point: Eye-level targets for Spanish averages, with 17 cm head and camera on top: average man 1,76 m -> eye level about 163 to 166 cm -> legs of about 146 to 149 cm; the Vanguard (148 cm) reaches it on its legs. Average woman 1,62 m -> eye level about 149 to 152 cm -> legs of about 132 to 135 cm; all five reach it on their legs.
Location headshots by plane: Iberia's 56 cm cabin-bag length takes the Befree (43 cm), Feisol and MT190XPRO4 (49 cm) and 055 (54 cm), not the Vanguard kit (77 cm).
Maker metric figures instead of conversions, including Vanguard's 148 cm / 174 cm / 77 cm for the VEO 3+ kit and Feisol Europe's 140 cm / 174 cm for the CT-3442.
